messages:
elyse_cs: Quick kickoff — Helios Labs onboarding week 0. Handing over from sales. Objective: have a working API integration + 2 pilot flows by EOW week 4. Owners below, pls ack and add missing folks.

sam_pm: Owners: Sam (PM) - product/acceptance, Jordan (Eng) - infra + model pinning, Lia (CS) - success/renewal, Kevin (Enablement) - training. @all — confirm

jordan_se: on infra: they requested private deployment in eu-west-1 and bring-your-own-key. Need network checklist from their infra team. ETA to get baseline infra up: 5 business days once we have VPC peering info.

lia_success_manager: Success criteria I'm tracking:
- Prod-like inference latency < 300ms p95
- Two pilot flows with automation (billing + support) validated
- Admins trained + runbook handed over
If any of these slip >1 week, renewal risk flag.

kevin_enablement: Proposed enablement plan:
Week 1: intro + API walkthru (1h)
Week 2: prompt/guardrails workshop (2h)
Week 3: ops/troubleshooting + runbook walkthrough (1h)
Will prepare slides and a short quiz. Need a seat list from Helios.

elyse_cs: I'll request seat list and VPC info from their infra. Also capturing initial health metric: usage target 10k tokens/day by week 4.

onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: https://cal.example.com/helios-onboard | Meeting times tentative — accept to lock.

sam_pm: Jordan — can you confirm model pinning approach? we'd prefer Llama-3-8b-quant (compat) for cost.

jordan_se: yes. We'll start with 8b quant, enable KV cache and 8k context. Need client to agree to sequence limits.

lia_success_manager: Noted renewal risk: procurement contract ends in 6 months. If adoption < 50% of target by week 8 we'll open renewal escalation. Recording action items below.

elyse_cs: Action items:
1) Elyse — request infra contact + seat list (today)
2) Jordan — prep deployment runbook + model pin recommendation (48h)
3) Kevin — enablement slides + invite (72h)
4) Sam — acceptance criteria doc + SLA expectations (72h)

kevin_enablement: :thumbsup: I'll draft training and share in #docs

sam_pm: Ok, thumbs up. I'll update the onboarding Trello and post links here.

elyse_cs: Thanks team — ping me with blockers. I'll follow up with Helios by EOD.
